samsung.notes: Prefer standard ADB authorization. Reconnect USB after revoking debugging authorizations if reverse-port setup repeatedly fails.

xiaomi.notes: Some MIUI/HyperOS devices may require USB debugging plus additional security/USB installation permissions for companion APK installation.

motorola.notes: Use File Transfer/Android Auto USB mode if Windows does not enumerate the ADB interface reliably.

google.notes: Modern Android Wireless Debugging is recommended when USB transport is unstable.

oneplus.notes: Verify USB debugging authorization after OxygenOS security updates.

oppo.notes: ColorOS may expose extra USB security toggles. Keep installation permissions enabled while installing the companion APK.

realme.notes: If APK installation is blocked, check developer USB installation/security settings.

vivo.notes: Some Funtouch/OriginOS versions require additional developer security confirmation for ADB installs.

nothing.notes: Standard Android ADB flow expected. Wireless debugging is supported on modern Android versions.
